title: Teichmüller and moduli spaces for complex nilmanifolds
summary: We develop several tools to study the local and global structure of the Teichmüller and moduli spaces for complex nilmanifolds. As a starting point, we prove a structure theorem for holomorphic maps between complex nilmanifolds, which allows for an explicit description of the Teichmüller and moduli spaces. We then introduce two period maps, and give general criteria for the existence of a complex structure on these spaces.
